Class LibraryService

java.lang.Object
library.service.LibraryService
public class LibraryService extends Object
Holds all books and enforces the rules of the library.

Books are stored in a LinkedHashMap keyed by book ID. A map makes the duplicate-ID check and every lookup O(1), and it keeps the books in the order they were added. The user interface never touches the map directly; it only calls the methods of this class.

Author:
Naseem, Amaan, Waseem

  • Method Details

    • addBook

      public Book addBook(String id, String title, String author) throws ValidationException, DuplicateBookException
      Adds a new book after validating the input.

      Leading and trailing spaces are removed from every field. The new book starts as AVAILABLE.

      Parameters:
      id - the unique book ID
      title - the book title
      author - the author's name
      Returns:
      the book that was added
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the ID, title or author is empty
      DuplicateBookException - if a book with this ID already exists

    • getAllBooks

      public List<Book> getAllBooks()
      Returns every book in the order it was added.

      The returned list is a copy, so changing it does not change the library.

      Returns:
      a new list of all books; empty if the library has no books

    • searchBooks

      public List<Book> searchBooks(String query, BookStatus statusFilter)
      Searches the books by text and, optionally, by status.

      A book matches the text if its ID, title or author contains the search text, ignoring upper and lower case. An empty search text matches every book. If statusFilter is not null, only books with that status are returned.

      Parameters:
      query - the text to look for; null or empty matches all
      statusFilter - the status to keep, or null for any status
      Returns:
      a new list of the matching books, in the order they were added

    • countByStatus

      public int countByStatus(BookStatus status)

      Returns:
      how many books currently have this status

    • loadBooks

      public void loadBooks(List<Book> loaded)
      Adds books that were read from a saved file.

      Books whose ID is already in the library are skipped, so loading can never create a duplicate ID.

      Parameters:
      loaded - the books to add

    • updateBook

      public Book updateBook(String id, String newTitle, String newAuthor) throws ValidationException, BookNotFoundException
      Changes the title and author of an existing book.

      All input is validated before anything is changed, so a failed update never leaves a book half-modified. The ID and the status are not changed by this method.

      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the book to update
      newTitle - the new title
      newAuthor - the new author
      Returns:
      the updated book
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the ID, title or author is empty
      BookNotFoundException - if no book has this ID
